title: What you guys think about this?
author: Zhaninja
selftext: It's fair to say that Steam became something like Roblox and playmarket. But you still find gems in both. Sure, there's a lot more bad games releasing now, but smart people that knows gamedev and can make good games without AI if assisted with it could reach new potential and make better game than vibecoder or antiAi people without either skills. I think with bad games oversaturated market we potentially could get more good games all it takes is good filtering system. Also if anybody could make their dream game, maybe that would shook up the big AAA corporations to finally make good games for people. Gaming market was stagnating to this point and those big companies kept disappointing us.

comments.author: Confident-Log1321
comments.body: You can make incredible games with ai, a for loop written by ai vs a developer is the same for loop ,the for loop will work exactly the same. The problem is there are too many vibe coders producing shit.

replies.author: Zhaninja
replies.body: I agree. I'm saying that same was happening in Roblox and stupid slop games on mobile even before Ai. All we need is good filtering system, rating, or quality control before shipping games to fix that.

comments.author: NoMacJustMagic
comments.body:
Mostly agree. AI lowers the cost of making something, it doesn't lower the cost of making something good. You still need taste, design sense and a lot of playtesting, and that's exactly where people with real gamedev skills will pull ahead.

The filtering part is the real bottleneck though. Discovery was already brutal before AI. I think the devs who will stand out are the ones who show their process and build a small community early, not just drop a store page and hope the algorithm finds them.

comments.author: Vegetable_Voice_2044
comments.body:
Roblox has an absolutely atrocious "experience" interface. And it's endless copies of the same junk. Good luck finding anything that isn't a rip off of everything else.

There are some gems in there, but it's hardly worth looking through the trash.
